candidates.description: This feature vector activates on subword tokens commonly found in Hindi words and names transliterated into the Latin or Devanagari script.
These tokens are variations and syllables containing the Devanagari retroflex sibilant letter 'ष' (sha).
This vector activates on Hindi vowel signs, nasalization markers, and consonant-vowel combinations in the Devanagari script.
This feature vector activates strongly on characters and subwords from the Devanagari script alongside Greek letters.
This feature vector activates on common subwords and characters frequently found in Hindi text.
This feature vector represents the Devanagari script character 'द' and its common conjuncts or vowel combinations.
This vector is related to the Hindi letter 'अ' (a) and its common syllabic combinations or character forms.
This vector represents Hindi vowel matras and common punctuation marks or hyphenated word endings.
This feature vector activates strongly for Hindi vowel signs, consonant-vowel combinations, and character fragments in the Devanagari script.
This vector activates for common Hindi vowel-sign and consonant suffixes that form grammatical endings and syllable combinations.
